title: AG41004: Manufacture And Testing Of Agricultural Machinery
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Foundry Practices: Principles of casting and forming. Heat treatment,
annealing. Fabrication and Manufacture: Welding, soldering and brazing. Nontraditional methods of machining. Tooling, Jigs and Fixtures: Principles of
planning and tool design. Control of machine tools. Jigs and fixtures.
Robotics: Robot technology. Robot applications in manufacturing. Manufacturing
Systems: Standardization. Manufacturing of production models of farm machines.
Computer integrated manufacturing systems with applications to agricultural
equipment. Testing: Testing of field machines. Standards.
